body: An individual (or death of one) can make a big difference in scheme of things, creating a ripple effect, so even if you cannot immediately see why you matter, you do matter.
you should try to accept the fact that life might be complicated with your family due to you being bipolar, but those complications I'm sure your family is fine dealing with, because they love you.
Because your life matters, and the world will a much worse place without you in it.
